scope.purpose: validate the provider-backed container identity of the production producer and the evidence of it
scope.runtime: local producer capture under a hostile environment - no Modal invocation, no provider query, no deployment, no GPU, no change to a deployed worker
scope.benchmark_run: not touched - the 16-target run on disk still fails the Iteration 16-18 validators and this iteration does not change that

checks.planned: the source of the production producer reads neither MODAL_WORKER_ID (the SDK's 'worker_id' configuration setting, documented as internal debugging use), nor HOSTNAME (a generic container hostname), nor MODAL_TASK_ID (read only by an internal experimental module) - none of them is a provider-issued container identifier
the capture was made locally: no Modal invocation, no provider query, no deployment, no GPU and no change to a deployed worker
the sentinel that stood in for modal.running_app while the producer ran was never touched
the capture ran with MODAL_WORKER_ID, HOSTNAME and MODAL_TASK_ID set to fake, well-formed values, and the container id stayed NOT_AVAILABLE
every identity fact of the envelope is a typed fact that names the worker side, and every observed fact names a registered observation source
the worker envelope holds no observed container id and no raw container id value: the worker attests only what the SDK gives it
'container_id' is an explicit NOT_AVAILABLE with the exact reason of the producer and holds no value

the client-observed facts name the client side, the worker envelope holds no client-side fact, and the client-side container id is either an explicit absence or correlated to the very function call the worker observed
the SHA-256 of the stage evidence artifact on disk equals the digest the capture record claims
the stage evidence artifact satisfies the unchanged Iteration 18 artifact contract and carries exactly the envelope of the captured response
the facts derived from the envelope keep the side the envelope declared
the provenance block of the capture satisfies the repository's own provenance validator in the strict source mode, with the stage evidence artifact of this very capture as its evidence
the capture names the commit it was made from, and that commit is the one the report is bound to

interpretation.planned: validate the source of the fixed production producer, the hostile environment the capture ran in, the registry of the allowed observation sources, the client-side correlation, the unchanged Iteration 18 artifact contract, the provenance consumer and the binding of the report to the code SHA it was produced from
interpretation.attempted: the producer source, the sentinel on modal.running_app, the spoofed environment, the envelope of the capture, the client-observed block, the stage evidence artifact and its digest, the provenance block and the source binding
interpretation.executed: the checks were executed against the artifacts stored on disk
interpretation.observed: the report states exactly what the capture record, the stage evidence artifact and the provenance block contain; a fact the worker cannot observe is reported as NOT_AVAILABLE with its reason and is never filled in
interpretation.reported: PASSED means every check of the provider-backed container identity passed; FAILED means at least one did not. The capture is a LOCAL capture of the producer: no Modal invocation was made, the provider was never asked, no worker was deployed and no live validation is claimed. The deployed workers still need a new deployment to carry the fix, and that is outside this iteration
